starts.note: customer: the job starts when the customer asks to close a credit card. Inside this protocol the agent offers each retention option: suggesting another Rho-Bank card, a fee waiver, a downgrade or the retention offer. A write runs only after the customer accepts it.

info.ask: Which credit card would you like to close?

info.about: The account's open date, its outstanding balance, any open or under_review disputes on this card, and any non-final replacement orders.
Why the customer wants to close. It maps to one of: annual_fee, not_using_card, found_better_card, unhappy_with_rewards, simplifying_finances, negative_experience, other.

info.about: If a balance remains: whether the customer authorizes paying it from their Rho-Bank checking account, and the amount.

info.about: Whether the customer accepts the tier-based retention offer (statement credit or bonus points) or still wants to close.
info.ask: As a thank-you for staying, I can offer you a statement credit or bonus points. Would you like to keep the card with this offer?

info.about: The customer's annual income. Needed only if the customer applies for another Rho-Bank card with apply_for_credit_card.

info.about: Whether the customer has a Rho-Bank+ subscription. apply_for_credit_card needs it. It also decides Gold Rewards Card eligibility and the Silver Rewards Card foreign transaction fee.

info.about: For the annual_fee reason: whether the customer accepts the one-year fee waiver or the downgrade to a no-annual-fee card

info.about: For negative_experience: what happened, and whether it was a service issue

steps.do: Compare the terms of every personal Rho-Bank card (see rules) with the features the customer named: reward rate, foreign transaction fee and annual fee. Recommend only a card the customer can apply for that matches or beats them. Never recommend the Diamond Elite Card, which is invitation-only. Recommend the Gold Rewards Card only if the customer has Rho-Bank+. For a high flat rate on all purchases with no foreign transaction fee, the Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% on all eligible purchases, charges a 0% foreign transaction fee and has a $200.00 annual fee. It gives a $150.00 rebate when $7500.00 is spent in every month of the cardmember year. Check get_time before mentioning any promotion, and mention it only if its window is open. If no card is similar or better, say so and go to retention_offer. Otherwise offer to help the customer apply instead of closing.

steps.do: Work out the customer's tenure from the account open dates in get_cc_accounts and the current time from get_time. At 2 years or more, offer a one-year annual fee waiver as a loyalty benefit. Under 2 years, offer a permanent downgrade to the no-annual-fee card in the same category: Bronze Rewards Card for a personal card, Business Bronze Rewards Card for a business card. Explain that account history and the credit line are kept, and that rewards and benefits change to the new tier.

open_questions: No tool or document says how to award retention bonus points. Only the statement credit has a tool.
Where tenure for the 2+ year fee waiver test comes from: the card's open date, or a customer-since field.
No tool reads the customer's credit score before a card with a minimum score is recommended (for example Platinum 750). The application decides.
The documents do not say whether the old card should be closed after the customer applies for a different Rho-Bank card. The protocol says apply 'instead of closing', so the old card is kept open.
No tool is named for checking bonus category enrollment for the unhappy_with_rewards reason.
'Escalate to a supervisor' names no tool. transfer_to_human_agents, with the customer's consent, is assumed.

The library also holds credit_card_retention_and_account_closure, credit_card_retention_protocol_annual_fee and credit_card_retention_protocol_found_better_card. They describe the same procedure but were not merged here, so their steps are not lost. A later merge could combine them into this job.
The documents do not say whether personal-card customers may be pointed to business cards.

changelog.why: New job. No library job is the closure-only procedure. It is guarded so that it never closes an account the retention job has already closed.
changelog.quote: Use the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool to process the closure.

when.quote: Before attempting retention, confirm the customer is eligible to close their account. Check these in order:

starts.note: The customer starts this by asking to close a credit card. The retention steps (finding the reason, suggesting another Rho-Bank card, the retention offer) are offers the agent makes under this protocol. The agent writes nothing the customer has not accepted.
starts.quote: Found a better card: Ask what features attracted them. If Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offer to help them apply instead of closing the current account.

tools.not_used: This job does not close the account. The processing_credit_card_account_closures job does, after the customer turns down retention or when retention is skipped.

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These are matched against the user's records
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me two of the following: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: The name or email used to look up the customer's record
info.ask: Could you please tell me your full name or the email on your account?

info.about: Which credit card account the customer wants to close, if they hold more than one
info.ask: Which of your Rho-Bank credit cards would you like to close?

info.about: Why the customer wants to close the card. It maps to one of the allowed closure_reason values
info.ask: May I ask why you'd like to close this card?

info.about: For found_better_card: what attracted the customer to the other card (rewards rate, foreign transaction fee, annual fee, bonus)
info.ask: What features of the other card appealed to you?

info.about: The customer's annual income, needed for apply_for_credit_card
info.ask: For the application, what is your annual income?

info.about: Whether the customer has a Rho-Bank+ subscription. Needed for apply_for_credit_card, and it decides Gold eligibility and the Silver foreign fee
info.ask: Do you currently have a Rho-Bank+ subscription?

info.about: Whether the customer takes the bonus points or the statement credit, or declines
info.ask: Would you prefer the bonus points or the statement credit, or would you still like to close the account?

steps.do: Ask for the customer's name or email and for any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number or address. Look up the record with get_user_information_by_name (case sensitive), by email, or by id, and check that the 2 values match. If they do not match, share no account information and do not continue.

args.customer_name: the customer's stated full name (or use get_user_information_by_email with the customer's stated email)

steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log, for account age and tenure, and for any date sums.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Log the verification record with the verified user's record values and the current time.
steps.if: the customer gave 2 values that match the record
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Fetch the verified user's credit card accounts. Identify the account to close (its credit_card_account_id, card type, open date and current balance). If the customer holds more than one card, ask which one.
steps.quote: credit_card_account_id (string): The unique identifier for the credit card account to be closed. This can be found in the customer's account profile or by looking up their credit card accounts.

steps.do: Unlock and call get_user_dispute_history_7291 for the verified user. If any dispute on this account has a status that is not final (for example open or under_review), the account is not eligible: tell the customer to wait for the dispute to resolve, and stop.
steps.quote: Pending disputes: The account must not have any active or pending transaction disputes. If present, advise the customer to wait for resolution before closing.

steps.do: Unlock and call get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 for the account. If any order is in a non-final state (pending or shipped), the account is blocked from closure: tell the customer the replacement must be delivered or cancelled first, and stop.
steps.quote: If any order is in a non-final state (for example, pending or shipped), consider the account blocked from closure.

steps.do: Using the account's open date and the current time, check that the account has been open for at least 60 days. If not, tell the customer they cannot close yet, and stop. Then check that the outstanding balance is 0. If it is not, tell the customer they must pay it off before closure, and stop.
steps.quote: Minimum account age: The account must be open for at least 60 days. If not, inform the customer they cannot close yet.

steps.do: Unlock and call get_closure_reason_history_8293 for the account. If it has any closure reason record within the past year (compare against get_time), tell the customer you will proceed with their closure request, skip every retention step, and go to the processing_credit_card_account_closures job.
steps.if: every eligibility check passed
steps.quote: Use the get_closure_reason_history_8293 tool to determine whether this specific credit card account has any closure reason records within the past year. If records exist for this account within that time frame, skip retention offers and proceed directly to processing the closure.

steps.do: Ask the customer why they want to close the account. Map the answer to exactly one of: annual_fee, not_using_card, found_better_card, unhappy_with_rewards, simplifying_finances, negative_experience, other.
steps.if: check_closure_history found no records within the past year
steps.quote: Ask the customer why they want to close their account. Then log it using log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521.

steps.do: Unlock and call log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521 with exactly three arguments and no others.
steps.if: the customer gave a closure reason and check_closure_history found no records within the past year
steps.quote: Note: Only these three arguments are accepted. Do not add additional parameters.

steps.do: Ask what features of the other card attracted the customer: cash back rate, foreign transaction fee, annual fee, sign-up bonus.
steps.if: closure_reason is found_better_card
steps.quote: Found a better card: Ask what features attracted them. If Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offer to help them apply instead of closing the current account.

steps.do: Compare each Rho-Bank personal card's own terms (see rules) against the features the customer named. Pick a card the customer can apply for that matches or beats them. Do not suggest the Diamond Elite Card (it is invitation only). Do not suggest the Gold Rewards Card unless the customer has Rho-Bank+. Describe the card's earn rate, foreign transaction fee and annual fee, including any rebate or waiver, and use get_time to check whether any promo window is still open. If no card is similar or better, go to retention_offer.
steps.if: closure_reason is found_better_card
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: If the customer wants the suggested card, ask for their annual income and whether they have Rho-Bank+. Have them apply with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. Do not close the current card.

args.card_type: the card chosen in compare_cards, by its exact name (e.g. 'Platinum Rewards Card')

steps.if: the customer accepts the suggested card
steps.quote: Found a better card: Ask what features attracted them. If Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offer to help them apply instead of closing the current account.

steps.do: Work out the customer's tenure from the account records and the current time. If it is 2 years or more, offer to waive the annual fee for one year. If it is under 2 years, offer a permanent downgrade to a no-annual-fee card, which keeps the account history.
steps.if: closure_reason is annual_fee
steps.quote: If they have been a customer for less than 2 years, offer a permanent downgrade to a no-annual-fee card while preserving account history.

steps.do: Unlock and call apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 to waive the annual fee for one year.
steps.if: closure_reason is annual_fee, tenure is 2+ years, and the customer accepts the waiver
steps.quote: Annual fee concerns: If they have been a customer for 2+ years, offer to waive their annual fee for one year as a loyalty benefit. Use apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 (see tool arguments below).

steps.do: Confirm the customer understands the benefit changes and that account history and credit line are kept. Then unlock and call downgrade_credit_card_3847, staying in the same category (personal to Bronze Rewards Card, business to Business Bronze Rewards Card).

args.target_card_type: 'Bronze Rewards Card' for a personal card, 'Business Bronze Rewards Card' for a business card

steps.if: closure_reason is annual_fee, tenure is under 2 years, and the customer accepts the downgrade
steps.quote: Use downgrade_credit_card_3847 to process the downgrade.

steps.do: Remind the customer of card benefits they may be missing, and suggest a recurring subscription to keep the card active.
steps.if: closure_reason is not_using_card
steps.quote: Not using the card: Remind them of benefits they may be missing and suggest setting up a recurring subscription to keep the card active.

steps.do: Review the card's reward categories against the customer's spending in their transactions, and suggest ways to earn more.
steps.if: closure_reason is unhappy_with_rewards
steps.quote: Unhappy with rewards: Check enrollment in available bonus categories and suggest ways to maximize rewards based on spending patterns.

steps.do: Apologize and gather the details. For a service-related complaint, consider a modest goodwill credit (apply_statement_credit_8472, reason 'goodwill_adjustment'). If escalation is warranted, ask the customer whether they want to be transferred, and if so call transfer_to_human_agents.
steps.if: closure_reason is negative_experience, escalation is warranted, and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: Negative experience: Apologize and gather details. Escalate to a supervisor if warranted. Consider offering a modest goodwill credit for service-related complaints.

steps.do: If the customer still wants to close after their concern has been addressed, make ONE offer based on the card's tier: Entry 500 bonus points or $5 statement credit; Mid 2,000 points or $20; Premium (Gold) and above 5,000 points or $50. Get the tier from the card type.
steps.if: the customer still wants to close after their concern was addressed
steps.quote: If the customer still wants to close after addressing their concerns, make one retention offer based on their card tier:

steps.do: Unlock and call apply_statement_credit_8472 for the statement credit at the tier amount.
steps.if: the customer accepts the statement credit option of the retention offer
steps.quote: 'retention_offer': Credit offered to retain a customer

steps.do: If the customer declines the retention offer, or retention was skipped because of prior records, thank them for being a Rho-Bank customer and go to processing_credit_card_account_closures. Do not apply pressure.
steps.if: the customer declines the retention offer or check_closure_history found records within the past year
steps.quote: If the customer declines the retention offer (or was ineligible due to prior attempts), thank them for being a Rho-Bank customer and proceed with closure. Do not apply pressure.

rules.rule: If any closure eligibility requirement fails (pending dispute, pending replacement, account under 60 days old, nonzero balance), explain what must be resolved and make no retention offers
rules.quote: If any requirement is not met, explain what must be resolved and do not proceed with retention offers.

rules.rule: The account must have a $0 balance
rules.quote: Outstanding balance: The account must have no outstanding balance. If a balance remains, the customer must pay it off before closure.

rules.rule: A pending replacement card blocks closure
rules.quote: No pending replacement cards: If a replacement has been ordered and not yet received or activated, a closure cannot proceed.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card: 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases
rules.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card: 0% foreign transaction fee
rules.quote: Foreign transaction fee: 0% on international purchases.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card: annual fee $200.00
rules.quote: Annual fee: $200.00.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card: a $150.00 annual fee rebate if the $7500.00 monthly spend threshold is met in every month of the cardmember year
rules.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

rules.rule: Platinum first-year fee waiver promo applies only to applications from 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31; check the current time before mentioning it
rules.quote: The waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the promo window.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card minimum credit score 750
rules.quote: Minimum credit score required: $750.

rules.rule: Diamond Elite Card (5.0% cash back, 0% FX, $495.00 fee) is invitation-only; do not offer it as an application
rules.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

rules.rule: Gold Rewards Card: 2.5% cash back on all purchases, 0% FX, $0.00 annual fee, and Rho-Bank+ required
rules.quote: Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card: 4.0% only on travel and software, 1.0% otherwise. FX is 2.75% without a premium subscription and 0% with one
rules.quote: Foreign transaction fee without a premium subscription: 2.75%

rules.rule: Bronze Rewards Card: 2.75% FX fee, $0.00 annual fee
rules.quote: Foreign transaction fee on international purchases: 2.75%

rules.rule: EcoCard: 1.0% FX fee, $50.00 annual fee
rules.quote: Foreign transaction fee (international purchases): 1.0%.

rules.rule: Crypto-Cash Back: 2.0% rewards
rules.quote: You earn rewards at 2.0% on those transactions.

rules.rule: Card tiers for the retention offer: Gold is Premium tier, Platinum is Elite tier
rules.quote: Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00

rules.rule: Premium and above: 5,000 bonus points or a $50 statement credit
rules.quote: Premium and above: Offer 5,000 bonus points or a $50 statement credit

rules.rule: Mid-tier: 2,000 bonus points or a $20 statement credit
rules.quote: Mid-tier cards: Offer 2,000 bonus points or a $20 statement credit

rules.rule: Entry-tier: 500 bonus points or a $5 statement credit
rules.quote: Entry-tier cards: Offer 500 bonus points or a $5 statement credit

rules.rule: A downgrade stays within the same category
rules.quote: Customers may only downgrade within the same category (personal to personal, business to business).

draft.done_when: Either the customer kept the card because a concern was resolved (they applied for a better Rho-Bank card, got a fee waiver, downgrade or retention credit, or simply chose to stay), or an eligibility check failed and the customer was told what to resolve, or the customer still wants to close and the agent has moved to processing_credit_card_account_closures.

when.quote: Use the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool to process the closure.

starts.note: Only when the customer, after retention, still asks to close an eligible account (or retention was skipped because of closure records in the past year).
starts.quote: If the customer declines the retention offer (or was ineligible due to prior attempts), thank them for being a Rho-Bank customer and proceed with closure. Do not apply pressure.

tools.not_used: Already read in credit_card_retention_protocol.get_card_accounts. Re-read it only if the balance may have changed.

info.about: The customer's final confirmation that they want to close
info.ask: Just to confirm, would you like me to close this card now?

steps.do: Confirm that every eligibility check from the retention job passed: $0.00 balance, no pending disputes, account at least 60 days old, no pending replacement. If any check failed, do not close.
steps.quote: Confirm all eligibility requirements are met per 'How can I close a credit card account?':

steps.do: Unlock and call close_credit_card_account_7834. If it returns an error, tell the customer the closure could not be completed and offer a transfer to a human agent.
steps.if: all eligibility checks passed and the customer declined retention (or retention was skipped) and confirmed closure
steps.quote: Use the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool to process the closure.

steps.do: Tell the customer: a confirmation email and a final statement will arrive within several business days; they have 45 days to redeem unredeemed rewards; and if an annual fee posted within the last 37 days, a full refund may apply.
steps.if: close_account succeeded
steps.quote: Inform the customer they have 45 days after submitting the closure request to redeem unredeemed rewards; after that, rewards are forfeited.

rules.rule: Closure needs a $0.00 balance, no pending disputes, an account age of at least 60 days, and no pending replacement
rules.quote: Zero balance required: Your account must have an outstanding balance of $0.00 dollars.

rules.rule: An annual fee is fully refunded if the account is closed within 37 days of the fee posting
rules.quote: If the annual fee posted recently, advise that a full refund may be available if the closure occurs within 37 days of the fee being charged.

draft.done_when: The account is closed and the customer has been told about the confirmation email, the 45-day rewards window and the 37-day annual fee refund rule, or the closure was refused with the reason explained.
